coverage.main: Read all fifteen pages of arXiv 2202.07054v3 (17 July 2022; IEEE TGRS 2022): Sections I-V, Algorithms, Tables I-VI, Figures 1-9 and references. The IEEE version of record was not retrieved.
coverage.supplement: No appendix or supplement; the UAE-RS dataset and code are linked.
coverage.excluded_results: Diagonal (surrogate = target) cells of Tables I-II and IV-V are white-box. Figures 1-4 and 6-9 are qualitative.

result_groups.population: Test halves (random 50% splits) of UCM (2,100 images) and AID (10,000 images); four surrogates; nine target classifiers
result_groups.outcome: success rate SR = n_wrong / n_total, where n_total is 'the number of samples in the test set' and n_wrong the misclassified samples
result_groups.evidence: The denominator is explicitly the whole test set, so clean-misclassified samples and surrogate failures remain in the population. The outcome is ground-truth misclassification.

result_groups.population: Vaihingen and Zurich Summer test images (five each); four segmentation surrogates and other segmentation targets
result_groups.outcome: pixel-level SR: misclassified pixels over all valid test pixels
result_groups.evidence: All valid pixels are counted, but per-pixel clean-correct and source-success events are not the classification events of fields 2-3; coded by outcome mapping.

f1.evidence: No clean accuracy of the classifiers or clean segmentation accuracy is reported.

f2.evidence: The classification scope explicitly includes all test samples (no); the segmentation scope is unresolved by outcome mapping.

f3.evidence: Classification SR counts all test samples (no); segmentation is unresolved.

f4.evidence: Classification denominators follow from the 50% splits (1,050 UCM; 5,000 AID), and two-decimal rates would map to unique counts, but the split sizes are not printed and no cell was extracted.

f5.evidence: 'The perturbation level epsilon and the step size alpha in all methods are fixed to 1'; all methods use the L-infinity norm (the pixel scale is not restated).

f6.evidence: The official repository provides attack, pretraining and test scripts, including test_cls_uae_rs.py for the released UAE-RS adversarial dataset. The splits and checkpoints needed to recompute Tables I-II were not verified. Not executed.

artifact_checks.result: Linked in the paper. Listed via the GitHub API (37 files, head 12 May 2022): attack_cls.py, pretrain_cls.py, test_cls.py, test_cls_uae_rs.py and segmentation scripts. Not executed.

bounds_checks.reason: The population is unconditional, but no clean error on the same test halves is reported. A bound would require recomputing clean accuracy.
Pixel misclassification is not a per-image misclassification probability, and no clean baseline is given.
